summary: Examination dates are optional in manual and PDF-assisted subject creation. A date may be added or removed later; date-only exams are allowed today. Undated subjects have no exam countdown, event or reminders and are not automatically harvested. Planning uses the selected study window without inventing a deadline.
validation: Flutter Analyze is clean and all 208 Flutter tests passed. Historical SQLite schemas 1 and 2 upgrade to schema 3 with all table rows and foreign keys preserved; the exam column accepts SQL NULL. Removal cancels old reminders. JSON/backup round-trips, manual/PDF creation, recommendations and planning without an exam are covered.
